title: Immunofluorescence Analysis of CD31
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iv7ce9n
materials: The slides were allowed to reach room temperature.
Primary antibody (BD Pharmingen (cat. no. 550300; India)) in 1% NGS-PBS was applied at 4°C overnight.
Secondary antibody (Thermo Fisher (cat. no. A21121)) in 1% NGS-PBS was applied for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Section frozen muscle
steps.instruction: Cut frozen muscle sections of 5 mm thickness using a cryostat and mount them onto microscope slides.

steps.title: Permeabilize slides
steps.instruction: Incubate the slides in 0.3 % Triton X‑100 in PBS for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Apply a blocking solution of 5 % normal goat serum in PBS and incubate for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides three consecutive times with PBS, each wash lasting 5 min.
